Their sum is h(x)+2cos x, h=x(x⁴+2x²−2)/(1+x²)^(5/2). Putting y=x²≥0 yields exactly (1+y)^5−y(y²+2y−2)^2=1+y+18y²+10y³+y⁴>0, hence |h|<1 for every finite real x. Therefore |f’’’|−|f’|<=|f’’’+f’|<3; L0=3 valid at L1=1. At x=2πn tending to infinity, f’->0 and f’’’->3, making every L0<3 invalid. Symbolic independent differentiation and polynomial subtraction rerun exactly in SymPy; grid scripts are only consistency checks, not proof of global bound or asymptotic optimality.
